profile.headline: Software Engineer at Sprout Social, Inc.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built distributed backend systems in Java and Python to ingest, process, and analyze high volume data from third party APIs, transforming raw data into customer facing analytics and reporting.
•  Implemented a social media benchmarking service that analyzed engagement across 37M+ profiles, enabling users to compare their performance against similar profiles.
•Led the redesign of Twitter data ingestion, consolidating four applications into two and migrating to the new API without interrupting data ingestion.
•Reduced API response times from ~1 minute to milliseconds by re-architecting the data retrieval processes.
• Migrated Java services to Kubernetes, standardizing deployments and automating container builds through ECR, GitHub Actions, and Jenkins.

positions.title: Software Implementation Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed, developed, and implemented software to monitor various applications for Cyber Fraud and Security using Java.
• Developed a framework that analyzes the Netezza Database web traffic in order to monitor any suspicious activity. Accomplished by reverse engineering Netezza's messaging protocol.
• Experienced in creating ETLs for a large datasets and utilizing it in an ElasticSearch cluster. Provided high availability and load balancing for the 24/7 cloud service.
• Identified production issues and delivered quick and effective solutions. Regularly completed root  cause analysis on complex problems.
• Collaborated with Agile development team to test, develop and maintain web and desktop-based software applications.
• Utilized Jira and Salesforce to improve support processes and streamline customer service actions.
• Worked closely with clients to coordinate project requirements, troubleshoot issues, and improve the performance of existing software.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Debugged and upgraded existing software components such as libraries, drivers, and applications
•	Collaborated with software engineering team to develop, review, and maintain new APIs
•	Evaluated test requirements, and design and execute tests to fulfill that requirement
•	Performed regression, functional, and performance testing on new and legacy software 
•	Developed a robust, easy to use library for external use
•	Automated the testing process cutting 20 hours of work into 15 minutes
•	Ensured software was compatible on multiple operating systems

projects.title: ePortfolio Generator
projects.description:
•	Developed a website generator application 
•	Application included blog post, slideshows, videos, images, and templates
•	Programed a user-friendly GUI using JavaFX
•	Implemented multiple software design patterns (builder, factory, singleton)
•	Included other technologies such as GIT, JSON, XML, and JavaScript

projects.title: HVAC System
projects.description:
•	Programmed an ATMega16 microcontroller to control an AC/Humidifier using Assembly 
•	Adaptive behavior in response to changes in temperature and humidity
•	Implemented the system as a finite state machine for greater modulation
•	Designed subroutines, and interrupts to improve performance
